_meta.dataset: Transit time matrix (hotel -> MICHELIN restaurant), computed live from Google Maps transit routing
_meta.tool: Google Maps directions (travelmode=transit), public route query
_meta.critical_finding: Las Vegas has NO subway / metro / light rail. Google Maps reports the transit mode as bus (RTC Deuce, Strip & Downtown Express, residential routes) and the Las Vegas Monorail. The user's 'subway or bus' requirement therefore resolves to BUS + MONORAIL only. Any claim of 'subway' travel in Las Vegas would be false.
_meta.measurement_note: Times are Google's live estimates at the query time (a Wednesday, pre-dawn). Real day-of-travel times vary with traffic, event nights and service frequency. Treat as planning estimates, not guarantees.
